3declare(strict_types=1);

5namespace GuzzleHttp\Promise;
6
7use Generator;
8
9/**
10 * Creates a promise that is resolved using a generator that yields values or
11 * promises (somewhat similar to C#'s async keyword).
12 *
13 * When called, the Coroutine::of method will start an instance of the generator
14 * and returns a promise that is fulfilled with its final yielded value.
15 *
16 * Control is returned back to the generator when the yielded promise settles.
17 * This can lead to less verbose code when doing lots of sequential async calls
18 * with minimal processing in between.
19 *
20 *     use GuzzleHttp\Promise;
21 *
22 *     function createPromise($value) {
23 *         return new Promise\FulfilledPromise($value);
24 *     }
25 *
26 *     $promise = Promise\Coroutine::of(function () {
27 *         $value = (yield createPromise('a'));
28 *         try {
29 *             $value = (yield createPromise($value . 'b'));
30 *         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
31 *             // The promise was rejected.
32 *         }
33 *         yield $value . 'c';
34 *     });
35 *
36 *     // Outputs "abc"
37 *     $promise->then(function ($v) { echo $v; });
38 *
39 * @template TValue = mixed
40 * @template TReason = mixed
41 *
42 * @implements PromiseInterface<TValue, TReason>
43 *
44 * @see https://github.com/petkaantonov/bluebird/blob/master/API.md#generators inspiration
45 */
46final class Coroutine implements PromiseInterface
47{
48    use NonSerializableTrait;
49
50    /**
51     * @var PromiseInterface<mixed, mixed>|null
52     */
53    private ?PromiseInterface $currentPromise = null;
54
55    /**
56     * @var Generator<mixed, mixed, mixed, mixed>
57     */
58    private Generator $generator;
59
60    /**
61     * @var Promise<TValue, TReason>
62     */
63    private PromiseInterface $result;
64
65    /**
66     * @param callable(): Generator<mixed, mixed, mixed, mixed> $generatorFn
67     */
68    public function __construct(callable $generatorFn)
69    {
70        $this->generator = $generatorFn();
71        $this->result = new Promise(function (): void {
72            while (isset($this->currentPromise)) {
73                $this->currentPromise->wait();
74            }
75        });
76        try {
77            $this->nextCoroutine($this->generator->current());
78        } catch (\Throwable $throwable) {
79            $this->result->reject($throwable);
80        }
81    }
82
83    /**
84     * Create a new coroutine.
85     *
86     * @param callable(): Generator<mixed, mixed, mixed, mixed> $generatorFn
87     *
88     * @return self<mixed, mixed>
89     */
90    public static function of(callable $generatorFn): self
91    {
92        return new self($generatorFn);
93    }
94
95    /**
96     * @template TFulfilledValue = never
97     * @template TFulfilledReason = never
98     * @template TRejectedValue = never
99     * @template TRejectedReason = never
100     *
101     * @param (callable(TValue): (TFulfilledValue|PromiseInterface<TFulfilledValue, TFulfilledReason>))|null $onFulfilled Invoked when the promise fulfills.
102     * @param (callable(TReason): (TRejectedValue|PromiseInterface<TRejectedValue, TRejectedReason>))|null   $onRejected  Invoked when the promise is rejected.
103     *
104     * @return PromiseInterface<($onFulfilled is null ? TValue : TFulfilledValue)|($onRejected is null ? never : TRejectedValue), ($onFulfilled is null ? never : TFulfilledReason|\Throwable)|($onRejected is null ? TReason : TRejectedReason|\Throwable)>
105     */
106    public function then(
107        ?callable $onFulfilled = null,
108        ?callable $onRejected = null
109    ): PromiseInterface {
110        return $this->result->then($onFulfilled, $onRejected);
111    }
112
113    /**
114     * @template TRejectedValue = never
115     * @template TRejectedReason = never
116     *
117     * @param callable(TReason): (TRejectedValue|PromiseInterface<TRejectedValue, TRejectedReason>) $onRejected Invoked when the promise is rejected.
118     *
119     * @return PromiseInterface<TValue|TRejectedValue, TRejectedReason|\Throwable>
120     */
121    public function otherwise(callable $onRejected): PromiseInterface
122    {
123        return $this->result->otherwise($onRejected);
124    }
125
126    public function wait(bool $unwrap = true)
127    {
128        return $this->result->wait($unwrap);
129    }
130
131    public function getState(): string
132    {
133        return $this->result->getState();
134    }
135
136    public function resolve($value = null): void
137    {
138        $this->result->resolve($value);
139    }
140
141    public function reject($reason): void
142    {
143        $this->result->reject($reason);
144    }
145
146    public function cancel(): void
147    {
148        if (isset($this->currentPromise)) {
149            $this->currentPromise->cancel();
150        }
151
152        $this->result->cancel();
153    }
154
155    private function nextCoroutine($yielded): void
156    {
157        $this->currentPromise = Create::promiseFor($yielded)
158            ->then([$this, '_handleSuccess'], [$this, '_handleFailure']);
159    }
160
161    /**
162     * @internal
163     */
164    public function _handleSuccess($value): void
165    {
166        $this->currentPromise = null;
167
168        try {
169            $next = $this->generator->send($value);
170            if ($this->generator->valid()) {
171                $this->nextCoroutine($next);
172            } else {
173                $this->result->resolve($value);
174            }
175        } catch (\Throwable $throwable) {
176            $this->result->reject($throwable);
177        }
178    }
179
180    /**
181     * @internal
182     */
183    public function _handleFailure($reason): void
184    {
185        $this->currentPromise = null;
186
187        try {
188            $nextYield = $this->generator->throw(Create::exceptionFor($reason));
189            // The throw was caught, so keep iterating on the coroutine
190            $this->nextCoroutine($nextYield);
191        } catch (\Throwable $throwable) {
192            $this->result->reject($throwable);
193        }
194    }
195}
